title: Which Avatar: The Last Airbender character are you? Free quiz — cv.cm
description: Free Avatar character quiz: answer 12 questions to find out if you're Aang, Katara, Sokka, Toph, Zuko, Iroh, Azula or Suki. Unofficial fan quiz, no sign-up.
lede: Playful like Aang, determined like Katara or wise like Uncle Iroh? Answer 12 questions about how you fight, travel and make friends to find your Avatar match.
about: Avatar: The Last Airbender is loved for characters who grow on a long journey: Aang's playfulness and kindness, Katara's hope and determination, Sokka's jokes and clever plans, Toph's toughness and honesty, Zuko's search for who he really is, Iroh's warmth and tea, Azula's drive for perfection and Suki's skill and steady leadership. This quiz matches you with one of these eight.

Your result names your character and shows your scores for all eight. If you'd rather know your bending element, try the Avatar element quiz on this site. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nickelodeon, Paramount or the show's creators; the names belong to their owners.

faq.a: Aang, Katara, Sokka, Toph, Zuko, Iroh, Azula and Suki.

faq.q: Is one result rarer than the others?
faq.a: No. Every character appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.

faq.q: How is this different from the Avatar element quiz?
faq.a: The element quiz tells you whether you'd bend water, earth, fire or air. This one matches your personality with a single character.
No. It is a free fan quiz, and your answers stay in your browser.

aang.name: Aang
aang.body: You are playful, kind and full of energy, and you try to find a peaceful way through every problem. You carry a lot on your shoulders but you still make time for fun and friendship. Your hope and gentleness are a strength, not a weakness.

katara.name: Katara
katara.body: You are caring, determined and quick to stand up for what's right. You keep your friends together, you never give up on people and you work hard to become strong. Remember to let others look after you sometimes too.

sokka.name: Sokka
sokka.body: You are funny, inventive and a natural planner. You may not have special powers, but your quick thinking, tactics and jokes get your team out of trouble again and again. You're the glue that keeps the group laughing.

toph.name: Toph Beifong
toph.body: You are tough, blunt and fiercely independent. You say what you think, you hate being underestimated and you're far stronger than anyone expects. Under the attitude you're loyal and you care more than you let on.

zuko.name: Zuko
zuko.body: You are passionate, driven and honest about your mistakes. You've had to work out who you really are, and you keep choosing to grow. Your story is proof that people can change, and that's one of the bravest things there is.

iroh.name: Uncle Iroh
iroh.body: You are warm, wise and patient, with a cup of tea always nearby. People come to you for comfort and advice, and you see the good in them even when they can't. You know that kindness and calm are their own kind of power.

azula.name: Azula
azula.body: You are brilliant, confident and very driven, and you hold yourself to perfect standards. You get results and people notice you. Be careful that the need to be the best doesn't cost you the people who'd stand by you; nobody has to be perfect.

suki.name: Suki
suki.body: You are skilled, disciplined and a steady leader. You train hard, protect the people who rely on you and stay calm when things go wrong. Others feel safe with you on their side.
